notes: Treasure's 'Add one mana of any color' pays a coloured symbol: the pool's {R} pays Eliminate's {1}, and its {B} can only come from a Treasure. Mana abilities are no menu rows (2026-11-11): the payer sacrifices a Treasure while a cost is paid, choosing its colour (CR 605.3a), so the pack casts with "tap": true. One Treasure (the payer takes the lowest Handle) is sacrificed for {B}, the other stays, and nothing floats. A sacrificed Treasure is a token that left the battlefield, so it ceases to exist (CR 704.5d): its zone is 'ceased'.
